name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

ledger.quote: Our guidance for FY26 remains unchanged. We expect our group order inflows and group revenues to grow at 10% and 15% respectively for FY26.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: Our Net Working Capital-to-Revenue guidance for March ‘26 remains at 12%. With respect to the margin in the Projects and Manufacturing portfolio, we continue to target the 8.3% to 8.5% range for the full year FY26.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: Our Net Working Capital-to-Revenue guidance for March ‘26 remains at 12%. With respect to the margin in the Projects and Manufacturing portfolio, we continue to target the 8.3% to 8.5% range for the full year FY26.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management revised target to close the year with Net Working Capital to Revenue of around 10%, and reported 4.1% for March 2026.
ledger.evidence: As anticipated, the ratio was marginally higher than 4.1% that we reported for March 26.

ledger.quote: expect this transaction to get consummated by the end of the current fiscal FY '26.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Nab paddy completed, but Hyderabad Metro sale transaction completion date was revised to 30th September 2026.
ledger.evidence: The estimated completion date for this transaction has been revised to 30th September 2026.

ledger.quote: So, we will not pursue any of those projects unless it meets those criteria.
ledger.speaker: Subramanian Sarma
ledger.verdict: Management stated they will not pursue projects unless meeting IRR criteria.

ledger.quote: And I think we are very positive that all of these tenders will be out by this calendar year, and they'll get awarded this year.
ledger.speaker: Subramanian Sarma
ledger.verdict: Management expressed positivity that Kuwait tenders will be out and awarded by CY2026.

ledger.quote: I expect Hydrocarbon business to come back on full strength maybe 2 or 3 quarters from now.
ledger.speaker: Subramanian Sarma
ledger.target: Hydrocarbon business back on full strength
ledger.verdict: Management expected Hydrocarbon business to come back on full strength 2 or 3 quarters from Feb 2026.

ledger.quote: We still see 4 - 5 GW opportunities for us, as a minimum in the coming years.
ledger.speaker: Subramanian Sarma
ledger.verdict: Management saw 4-5 GW opportunities in the coming years.

ledger.quote: And we do expect a lot of opportunities to come in the near term.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management expected opportunities in electrolyzers in the near term.

ledger.quote: Based on this visibility and the opportunities we are pursuing, we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management guided for group order inflows to grow 10% to 12% in FY27.

ledger.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management guided for revenue growth of 10% to 12% for FY27.

ledger.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management expected FY26 margins of 7.8% for Projects, Products and Manufacturing to be stable in FY27.

ledger.quote: Accordingly, we are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27, which remains well within our targeted range.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management guided working capital to be around 10% in FY27.

ledger.quote: The Lakshya L31 targets 13% to 15% revenue CAGR growth for over five years with EBIT margins of 16% to 17%, reflecting a structurally stronger and higher-quality growth profile.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management targeted 13% to 15% revenue CAGR growth for over five years under Lakshya L31.

ledger.quote: The strategy emphasizes disciplined portfolio expansion and strong risk management with targets of 20% plus loan book growth, while maintaining credit costs below 2%.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management targeted 20% plus loan book growth under Lakshya period.

ledger.quote: The financial outcomes under the plan are calibrated to deliver a 3% to 3.2% ROA and a 16% to 18% ROE, reinforcing sustainability of returns while scaling the franchise.
ledger.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
ledger.verdict: Management targeted Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17% over the next five years.

open.quote: Given the strength of our opportunity pipeline and the underlying market dynamics, we remain confident of achieving our order inflow growth guidance of 10% to 12% band for the current year.
open.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

open.quote: For now, we remain committed to our FY '27 growth guidance of 10% to 12% revenue growth guidance.
open.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

open.quote: In line with our Revenue growth guidance, we continue to target the margin of around 7.8% for FY '27 with respect to the PPM portfolio.
open.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

open.quote: Factoring in the expected utilization of customer advances and increased vendor payments as the execution accelerates in H2, we are maintaining our FY '27 working capital guidance of around 10%.
open.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

open.quote: And very soon, you will see some announcements coming from our side with respect to new awards in the Middle East.
open.speaker: Subramanian Sarma
open.target: new order announcements in Middle East

read: Management demonstrates a reliable track record in meeting guidance for order inflows, margins, and working capital targets. Most short-to-medium term commitments have been delivered or remain on track as reported.
questions: Why was the Hyderabad Metro Rail stake sale completion date revised to September 30, 2026?
When will the Kuwait tenders be fully awarded as previously projected for CY2026?
bull: Order inflow grew 14% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to Rs. 1,080 billion.
NWC to sales ratio improved to 4.9% in June 2026 from 10.1% in June 2025.
bear: Group level EBITDA margin excluding other income declined to 9.0% in Q1 FY27 from 9.9% in Q1 FY26.
Middle East conflict and supply chain disruptions pose potential risks to execution timelines and project costs.
